dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, Nam, what do you think of Toronto?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk əv təˈrɑːntoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I like it. Compared to Bangkok, it's very clean and quiet.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlaɪk ɪt. kəmˈpɛrd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk, ɪts ˈvɛri ˈkliːn ənd ˈkwaɪət.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Quiet? Toronto is the biggest city in Canada!
dialogue.reading: ˈkwaɪət? təˈrɑːntoʊ ɪz ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈsɪti ɪn ˈkænədə!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe, but compared with Bangkok, the traffic here is nothing!
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi, bʌt kəmˈpɛrd wɪð ˈbæŋkɑːk, ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈhɪr ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The pace of life is slower here. Unlike people in Bangkok, people here don't rush everywhere.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈpeɪs əv ˈlaɪf ɪz ˈsloʊər ˈhɪr. ʌnˈlaɪk ˈpiːpəl ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ˈpiːpəl ˈhɪr ˈdoʊnt ˈrʌʃ ˈɛvriwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Really? I always think Toronto is so busy. What about the weather?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈθɪŋk təˈrɑːntoʊ ɪz soʊ ˈbɪzi. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈwɛðər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The climate is the biggest difference. Bangkok is hot all year. In contrast, Toronto has four seasons.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈklaɪmət ɪz ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈdɪfrəns. ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈhɑːt ˈɔːl ˈjɪr. ɪn ˈkɑːntræst, təˈrɑːntoʊ ˈhæz ˈfɔːr ˈsiːzənz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And fall is the most beautiful one. Look at the trees!
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈfɔːl ɪz ðə ˈmoʊst ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈwʌn. ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈtriːz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know! Unlike you, I've never lived in a place with snow.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! ʌnˈlaɪk juː, aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈlɪvd ɪn ə ˈpleɪs wɪð ˈsnoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Well, you will soon. Wait until December!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, juː wɪl ˈsuːn. ˈweɪt ənˈtɪl dɪˈsɛmbər!
